jp: ヴェルニースの南にあるネフィアの迷宮群のひとつ《レシマス》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの南にあるネフィアの迷宮群のひとつ《レシマス》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。"
en: I should check the dungeon called Lesimas. It's located south of Vernis.
en_grezzo: "I should check the dungeon called Lesimas. It's located south of Vernis."
it: Forse a Lesimas, uno dei labirinti di Nefia a sud di Vernis, si trova qualcosa.

jp: 致命傷を負った斥候に、パルミアのジャビ王へ書簡を渡すよう頼まれた。パルミアには、ヴェルニースから東の街道を進めば辿り着ける。
jp_grezzo: "致命傷を負った斥候に、パルミアのジャビ王へ書簡を渡すよう頼まれた。パルミアには、ヴェルニースから東の街道を進めば辿り着ける。"
en: The injured scout asked me to deliver a letter to the king of Palmia. Palmia is located east of Vernis.
en_grezzo: "The injured scout asked me to deliver a letter to the king of Palmia. Palmia is located east of Vernis."
it: Un esploratore ferito a morte mi ha chiesto di consegnare una lettera al re di Palmia. A Palmia si arriva da Vernis, prendendo la strada verso est.

jp: ジャビ王によると、仕事が欲しい時は城の図書館にいるエリステアを訪ねればいいようだ。
jp_grezzo: "ジャビ王によると、仕事が欲しい時は城の図書館にいるエリステアを訪ねればいいようだ。"
en: Erystia will have some tasks for me if I want to work for Palmia. She's in the library of the castle.
en_grezzo: "Erystia will have some tasks for me if I want to work for Palmia. She's in the library of the castle."
it: Secondo il re Xabi, quando cerco lavoro basta che vada da Erystia, nella biblioteca del castello.

jp: レシマスに赴き、冒険者カラムという人物を探すよう依頼された。彼は最低でもレシマスの16階より先の階層にいるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "レシマスに赴き、冒険者カラムという人物を探すよう依頼された。彼は最低でもレシマスの16階より先の階層にいるらしい。"
en: Erystia asked to look for an adventurer called Karam in the dungeon of Lesimas. He was on the 16th level of the dungeon the last time he sent a report. I may have to go deeper if I am to find him.
en_grezzo: "Erystia asked to look for an adventurer called Karam in the dungeon of Lesimas. He was on the 16th level of the dungeon the last time he sent a report. I may have to go deeper if I am to find him."
it: Mi è stato chiesto di andare a Lesimas e cercare un avventuriero di nome Karam. Pare che si trovi almeno oltre il sedicesimo piano.

jp: 瀕死のカラムから得た情報を、パルミアのエリステアに伝えなければならない。
jp_grezzo: "瀕死のカラムから得た情報を、パルミアのエリステアに伝えなければならない。"
en: I need to bring information Karam gave me to Erystia at once.
en_grezzo: "I need to bring information Karam gave me to Erystia at once."
it: Devo riferire a Erystia, a Palmia, quello che mi ha detto Karam in fin di vita.

jp: レシマス最下層の封印を解く為に必要な三つの魔石の入手を依頼された。賢者の魔石は《灼熱の塔》に、愚者の魔石は《死者の洞窟》に、覇者の魔石は《古城》にある。
jp_grezzo: "レシマス最下層の封印を解く為に必要な三つの魔石の入手を依頼された。賢者の魔石は《灼熱の塔》に、愚者の魔石は《死者の洞窟》に、覇者の魔石は《古城》にある。"
en: I need to find 3 magic stones to break the seal of Lesimas. They can be found at the Tower of Fire, the crypt of the damned and the Ancient Castle
en_grezzo: "I need to find 3 magic stones to break the seal of Lesimas. They can be found at the Tower of Fire, the crypt of the damned and the Ancient Castle"
it: Mi è stato chiesto di procurare le tre pietre magiche che aprono il sigillo dell'ultimo piano di Lesimas: quella del saggio è nella Torre Rovente, quella del folle nella grotta dei morti, quella del conquistatore nel Castello Antico.

jp: 三つの魔石の力で最下層の封印を解き、レシマスの秘宝を持ち帰るようエリステアに依頼された。
jp_grezzo: "三つの魔石の力で最下層の封印を解き、レシマスの秘宝を持ち帰るようエリステアに依頼された。"
en: With 3 magic stones I have, I need to get to the deepest level of Lesimas and break the seal. Then bring back an item called Hidden Artifact of Lesimas, whatever it is.
en_grezzo: "With 3 magic stones I have, I need to get to the deepest level of Lesimas and break the seal. Then bring back an item called Hidden Artifact of Lesimas, whatever it is."
it: Erystia mi ha chiesto di aprire il sigillo dell'ultimo piano con le tre pietre magiche e di riportare il tesoro segreto di Lesimas.

jp: サウスティリスがあなたを呼んでいる。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリスがあなたを呼んでいる。"
en: South Tyris calls me.
en_grezzo: "South Tyris calls me."
it: Tyris del Sud ti chiama.

jp: サウスティリス中央部にある古代ネフィア《レミード遺跡》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリス中央部にある古代ネフィア《レミード遺跡》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。"
en: I should investigate the ruins of Nefia named Remido in the center of South Tyris. I might find something there.
en_grezzo: "I should investigate the ruins of Nefia named Remido in the center of South Tyris. I might find something there."
it: Forse alle Rovine di Remido, l'antica Nefia al centro di Tyris del Sud, si trova qualcosa.

jp: メルガスのラボにいるガベラという男に接触しよう。
jp_grezzo: "メルガスのラボにいるガベラという男に接触しよう。"
en: I should contact the man named Gavela in the laboratory in Melugas.
en_grezzo: "I should contact the man named Gavela in the laboratory in Melugas."
it: Devo mettermi in contatto con un uomo di nome Gavela, nel laboratorio di Melugas.

jp: カードキーを発行してもらう代わりに依頼品を持ってくるようにガベラに言われている。
jp_grezzo: "カードキーを発行してもらう代わりに依頼品を持ってくるようにガベラに言われている。"
en: Gavela has asked me to complete some tasks for him in exchange for a card key.
en_grezzo: "Gavela has asked me to complete some tasks for him in exchange for a card key."
it: Gavela mi ha chiesto di portargli certi oggetti in cambio di una chiave magnetica.

jp: サウスティリス中央部にある古代ネフィア《レミード遺跡》に潜り調査部隊と合流しよう。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリス中央部にある古代ネフィア《レミード遺跡》に潜り調査部隊と合流しよう。"
en: I need to join the investigation team in exploring Remido. The ruins are in the center of South Tyris.
en_grezzo: "I need to join the investigation team in exploring Remido. The ruins are in the center of South Tyris."
it: Devo scendere nelle Rovine di Remido, l'antica Nefia al centro di Tyris del Sud, e unirmi alla squadra di ricerca.

jp: ガベラに呼ばれている。一度メルガスへ行こう。
jp_grezzo: "ガベラに呼ばれている。一度メルガスへ行こう。"
en: Dr. Gavela has called me. I should drop by his lab in Melugas.
en_grezzo: "Dr. Gavela has called me. I should drop by his lab in Melugas."
it: Gavela mi cerca. Devo fare un salto a Melugas.

jp: レミード最下層の怪物を倒せないかガベラに相談してみよう。
jp_grezzo: "レミード最下層の怪物を倒せないかガベラに相談してみよう。"
en: I should consult with Gavela about a way to defeat the monster on the lowest level of Remido.
en_grezzo: "I should consult with Gavela about a way to defeat the monster on the lowest level of Remido."
it: Devo chiedere a Gavela come si può abbattere il mostro dell'ultimo piano di Remido.

jp: エイレル南東の山岳地帯に行き、超高純度のエーテルを回収しガベラに渡そう。
jp_grezzo: "エイレル南東の山岳地帯に行き、超高純度のエーテルを回収しガベラに渡そう。"
en: I need to head to the mountains southeast of Eirel and collect purified ether there, then hand it over to Gavela.
en_grezzo: "I need to head to the mountains southeast of Eirel and collect purified ether there, then hand it over to Gavela."
it: Devo andare sulle montagne a sud-est di Eirel, raccogliere etere purissimo e portarlo a Gavela.

jp: レミード遺跡最下層の怪物を倒そう。
jp_grezzo: "レミード遺跡最下層の怪物を倒そう。"
en: I need to defeat the monster on the lowest floor of Remido.
en_grezzo: "I need to defeat the monster on the lowest floor of Remido."
it: Devo abbattere il mostro dell'ultimo piano delle Rovine di Remido.

jp: 制圧した遺跡内を調査しよう。
jp_grezzo: "制圧した遺跡内を調査しよう。"
en: I should continue to explore Remido now that we have control of the ruins.
en_grezzo: "I should continue to explore Remido now that we have control of the ruins."
it: Ora che le rovine sono state espugnate, devo esplorarle.

jp: 地上へ帰ろう。
jp_grezzo: "地上へ帰ろう。"
en: I should return to the surface.
en_grezzo: "I should return to the surface."
it: Devo tornare in superficie.

jp: ノースティリスは今どうなっているだろう？関所を通過して様子を見に行こう。
jp_grezzo: "ノースティリスは今どうなっているだろう？関所を通過して様子を見に行こう。"
en: I wonder what's been happening in North Tyris? I should cross the border and find out.
en_grezzo: "I wonder what's been happening in North Tyris? I should cross the border and find out."
it: Chissà come vanno le cose a Tyris del Nord. Devo passare il valico e andare a vedere.

jp: パルミアで情報収集でもしようか。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアで情報収集でもしようか。"
en: I should gather some information in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "I should gather some information in Palmia."
it: Tanto vale raccogliere qualche informazione a Palmia.

jp: パルミアのエリステアと話をしてみよう。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアのエリステアと話をしてみよう。"
en: I should talk to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "I should talk to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Devo parlare con Erystia, a Palmia.

jp: ポート・カプールの船長に紹介状を見せよう。
jp_grezzo: "ポート・カプールの船長に紹介状を見せよう。"
en: I should show the boat captain in Port Kapul my letter of introduction.
en_grezzo: "I should show the boat captain in Port Kapul my letter of introduction."
it: Devo mostrare la lettera di presentazione al capitano di Porto Kapul.

jp: 浮遊大陸にある西の森の遺跡に人が集まっているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "浮遊大陸にある西の森の遺跡に人が集まっているらしい。"
en: Apparently people are gathering in the ruins in the wooded area on the western part of this floating continent.
en_grezzo: "Apparently people are gathering in the ruins in the wooded area on the western part of this floating continent."
it: Pare che alle rovine nel bosco a ovest del continente fluttuante si stia radunando gente.

jp: 帰る方法を探そう。
jp_grezzo: "帰る方法を探そう。"
en: I need to find a way to return to Tyris.
en_grezzo: "I need to find a way to return to Tyris."
it: Devo cercare un modo per tornare.

jp: メルガスでガベラに話をきこう。
jp_grezzo: "メルガスでガベラに話をきこう。"
en: I should go see Gavela in his lab in Melugas.
en_grezzo: "I should go see Gavela in his lab in Melugas."
it: Devo sentire Gavela, a Melugas.

jp: 古の庭園からメルガストでロストイルヴァへ行き、調査してまわろう。
jp_grezzo: "古の庭園からメルガストでロストイルヴァへ行き、調査してまわろう。"
en: I need to take the Melugast from the Ancient Garden to Lost Irva so that I can continue my investigation.
en_grezzo: "I need to take the Melugast from the Ancient Garden to Lost Irva so that I can continue my investigation."
it: Dal Giardino Antico devo prendere il Melugast per Irva Perduta e andare a indagare.

jp: ロストイルヴァの調査をしつつ神の間を目指そう。
jp_grezzo: "ロストイルヴァの調査をしつつ神の間を目指そう。"
en: I should investigate Lost Irva while aiming for The Eternal Seal.
en_grezzo: "I should investigate Lost Irva while aiming for The Eternal Seal."
it: Devo indagare su Irva Perduta e insieme puntare al Sigillo Eterno.

jp: 混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を目指そう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を目指そう。"
en: I should try to reach the Eternal Seal, located at the lowest level of the Cradle of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "I should try to reach the Eternal Seal, located at the lowest level of the Cradle of Chaos."
it: Devo puntare al Sigillo Eterno, in fondo alla Culla del Caos.

jp: 一度、エリステアに銀熊のことを報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "一度、エリステアに銀熊のことを報告しよう。"
en: I need to tell Erystia everything I learned from the Silver Bear immediately.
en_grezzo: "I need to tell Erystia everything I learned from the Silver Bear immediately."
it: Per prima cosa devo riferire a Erystia dell'orsa d'argento.

jp: ノルンの言うとおりにノースティリスと往復が出来るのか確かめよう。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンの言うとおりにノースティリスと往復が出来るのか確かめよう。"
en: I need to find out if I can make a round trip between North Tyris and Lost Irva like Norne said.
en_grezzo: "I need to find out if I can make a round trip between North Tyris and Lost Irva like Norne said."
it: Devo verificare se davvero si può fare avanti e indietro fra Tyris del Nord e Irva Perduta, come dice Norne.

jp: サウスティリスの方向から、何かに呼ばれているような感覚がする。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリスの方向から、何かに呼ばれているような感覚がする。"
en: I feel as if I'm being called by something in South Tyris.
en_grezzo: "I feel as if I'm being called by something in South Tyris."
it: Da Tyris del Sud arriva la sensazione che qualcosa mi stia chiamando.

jp: 海底から城が浮上し、世界が狂気に包まれようとしている。城へはサウスティリス南西のヴァルムから行ける。
jp_grezzo: "海底から城が浮上し、世界が狂気に包まれようとしている。城へはサウスティリス南西のヴァルムから行ける。"
en: A castle has emerged from the sea floor, and the entire world will soon be driven insane if something is not done. I can get there by a tortoise located in Valm in South Tyris.
en_grezzo: "A castle has emerged from the sea floor, and the entire world will soon be driven insane if something is not done. I can get there by a tortoise located in Valm in South Tyris."
it: Dal fondo del mare è emerso un castello, e il mondo sta per sprofondare nella follia. Al castello si arriva da Valm, a sud-ovest di Tyris del Sud.

jp: パルミアのエリステアから依頼を受けよう。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアのエリステアから依頼を受けよう。"
en: I should see what work Erystia in Palmia has for me.
en_grezzo: "I should see what work Erystia in Palmia has for me."
it: Devo farmi dare un incarico da Erystia, a Palmia.

jp: 関所にいるエユルとともに生体兵器を殲滅しよう。
jp_grezzo: "関所にいるエユルとともに生体兵器を殲滅しよう。"
en: I need to meet up with Regulus at the inn at North Tyris' border with South Tyris in order to defeat the biological weapon.
en_grezzo: "I need to meet up with Regulus at the inn at North Tyris' border with South Tyris in order to defeat the biological weapon."
it: Devo raggiungere Regulus al valico e sterminare con lui le armi biologiche.

jp: 生体兵器の殲滅をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "生体兵器の殲滅をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: We've destroyed the biological weapons. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "We've destroyed the biological weapons. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Devo riferire a Erystia che le armi biologiche sono state sterminate.

jp: ノイエルにいるマルカとともにメイルーンへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。
jp_grezzo: "ノイエルにいるマルカとともにメイルーンへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。"
en: I should head to Noyel and meet up with Marka so that was can deal with the demons in Mayroon.
en_grezzo: "I should head to Noyel and meet up with Marka so that was can deal with the demons in Mayroon."
it: Devo andare a Noyel da Marka e muovere con lei verso Mayroon, a combattere il demone.

jp: メイルーンの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "メイルーンの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: I've defeated the demon in Mayroon. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "I've defeated the demon in Mayroon. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Devo riferire a Erystia che il demone di Mayroon è stato abbattuto.

jp: ロストイルヴァの魔導船にいるライゼルとともにエウダーナへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。
jp_grezzo: "ロストイルヴァの魔導船にいるライゼルとともにエウダーナへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。"
en: I need to join forces with Raizel at the Eulderna Blimp in Lost Irva in order to face the demon of Vengeance that's assaulting Eulderna.
en_grezzo: "I need to join forces with Raizel at the Eulderna Blimp in Lost Irva in order to face the demon of Vengeance that's assaulting Eulderna."
it: Devo unirmi a Raizel, sulla Nave Magica Eulderna a Irva Perduta, e muovere verso Eulderna a combattere il demone.

jp: エウダーナの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: The demon in Eulderna has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "The demon in Eulderna has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Devo riferire a Erystia che il demone di Eulderna è stato abbattuto.

jp: ロストイルヴァ北端に存在する神艦から傭兵と一緒にキッカスへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。
jp_grezzo: "ロストイルヴァ北端に存在する神艦から傭兵と一緒にキッカスへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。"
en: I need to join forces with the mercenary waiting at the God's Warship in the northern reaches of Lost Irva to face the demon attacking Kikkasu.
en_grezzo: "I need to join forces with the mercenary waiting at the God's Warship in the northern reaches of Lost Irva to face the demon attacking Kikkasu."
it: Devo partire con il mercenario dalla Nave Divina, all'estremità nord di Irva Perduta, e muovere verso Kikkasu a combattere il demone.

jp: キッカスの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "キッカスの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: The demon in Kikkasu has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "The demon in Kikkasu has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Devo riferire a Erystia che il demone di Kikkasu è stato abbattuto.

jp: メルガスへ行き依頼を確認しよう。
jp_grezzo: "メルガスへ行き依頼を確認しよう。"
en: It was requested I go to Melugas.
en_grezzo: "It was requested I go to Melugas."
it: Devo andare a Melugas a sentire di che incarico si tratta.

jp: 混沌の巨城、10階の敵を倒そう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の巨城、10階の敵を倒そう。"
en: I need to defeat the enemy on the 10th floor of the Cradle of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "I need to defeat the enemy on the 10th floor of the Cradle of Chaos."
it: Devo abbattere il nemico al decimo piano della Culla del Caos.

jp: 悪魔の討伐をガベラに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "悪魔の討伐をガベラに報告しよう。"
en: I should report the demon's defeat to Gavela in Melugas.
en_grezzo: "I should report the demon's defeat to Gavela in Melugas."
it: Devo riferire a Gavela che il demone è stato abbattuto.

jp: 神立図書館でソピアーと話そう。
jp_grezzo: "神立図書館でソピアーと話そう。"
en: I have to talk with <Sophia> at the Sacred Library of Irva.
en_grezzo: "I have to talk with <Sophia> at the Sacred Library of Irva."
it: Devo parlare con <Sophia> alla Biblioteca Divina di Irva.

jp: 混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を目指そう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を目指そう。"
en: I should aim for the bottom of the Cradle of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "I should aim for the bottom of the Cradle of Chaos."
it: Devo puntare al Sigillo Eterno, in fondo alla Culla del Caos.

jp: 混沌の神を倒す時が来た。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神を倒す時が来た。"
en: It is time to beat the god of chaos.
en_grezzo: "It is time to beat the god of chaos."
it: È venuto il momento di abbattere il dio del caos.

jp: 混沌の超児を無力化しよう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の超児を無力化しよう。"
en: I have to neutralize the Chaos Child.
en_grezzo: "I have to neutralize the Chaos Child."
it: Devo neutralizzare <Il Figlio del Caos>.

jp: ロストイルヴァは平和になっただろうか？
jp_grezzo: "ロストイルヴァは平和になっただろうか？"
en: Did Lost Irva become peaceful?
en_grezzo: "Did Lost Irva become peaceful?"
it: Irva Perduta sarà tornata in pace?

jp: 気が向いたらノルンの頼み通りヴェルニースに向かおう。
jp_grezzo: "気が向いたらノルンの頼み通りヴェルニースに向かおう。"
en: If I have some spare time, I should visit Vernis as Norne requested.
en_grezzo: "If I have some spare time, I should visit Vernis as Norne requested."
it: Quando ne ho voglia, devo andare a Vernis come mi ha chiesto Norne.

jp: ロイターと接触して世界を行き来しつつ、探索していこう。
